note: Staged street geometry over TRUE Elsewhere location codes. Grid positions and street seconds are Portal presentation (staging), never measured world data. codeStatus 'verified' = the code is attested in ~/workspace/elsewhere/reference/openapi.json (Work enum / place codes) or the household's observed Elsewhere record (~/workspace/elsewhere/*.md); 'staging' = label-style code invented by Portal because no true code is verified for that place. provenanceClass (M2.06): 'feed-evidenced' = the code appears in Tier P feed data (voices places / map civic works); 'record-attested' = attested only in the household's Elsewhere record (~/workspace/elsewhere/PERSONA.md, research/01-elsewhere.md), never in the feed — the two anchor plots (District 3 Plot 18, District 1 Plot 31) are this class and must not be presented as Tier P data; 'staging' = Portal-invented, no verified code. A plot code evidenced in the feed but absent from this file (e.g. EMBER_DISTRICT_1_PLOT_30) gets a deterministic staging position in the app by sorted-code fill (build/app/logic.mjs effectiveLayout) — a placed building without a layout edit, its position staging like every position here. A plot with no evidence anywhere gets no node and no position, in this file or in the app.
